gloss: slipped disc; strained back; acute lower back pain

definitions.gloss: slipped disc; strained back; acute lower back pain
definitions.explanation: sudden severe lower back pain, often caused by lifting something heavy or making an awkward movement

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ぎっくり{腰|ごし}になった。
examples.english: I threw out my back lifting a heavy load.

examples.japanese: ぎっくり{腰|ごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: I can't move because of my strained back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぎっくり{腰|ごし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧。
examples.english: My father was hospitalized with a slipped disc.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The word ぎっくり is onomatopoeic, representing the sudden shock or snap felt when the back gives out.

MEDICAL TERM:
{急性腰痛症|きゅうせいようつうしょう} (acute lower back pain) is the formal medical term.

ALTERNATIVE NAME:
Also called 「⟦{魔女|まじょ}→魔女：14641_majo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一撃|いちげき}→一撃：08948_ichigeki⟧」 (witch's strike) in German-influenced medical terminology, similar to the German term "Hexenschuss."

PREVENTION:
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (lift with proper posture)
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧ (strengthen the lower back)
